items.title: Composition and cancellation of the Cohen-Macaulay property for morphisms of algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma gives four statements about the Cohen-Macaulay property under composition: it is preserved by composing Cohen-Macaulay morphisms, and it can be cancelled from a composite provided the first morphism is flat. The proof works etale locally, reducing each statement to the corresponding statement for schemes via a chart, and then reassembling; the flatness hypothesis in the cancellation statements is what allows the local reduction to see the intermediate morphism's property. The etale-local reduction with the flatness hypothesis is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 6329-6349.
